comparison.objective: Match two ground-glass stoppers to flask necks and seat both.
comparison.physical_skill: Size selection and tapered axial insertion of fragile parts.
comparison.success_condition: Both matching stoppers seated, released, still, and held for 1 second; wrong-size fits fail.
comparison.reason: Taper matching and insertion do not test preserving a screw adjustment under jam-nut countertorque or verifying retained gripper motion.
